id.description: Custom category identifier. If not provided, it is automatically generated

type.description: Category type, by default it is `STANDARD`.

localizedName.description: Localized category name in a form of a map of translations.

localizedDescription.description: Localized category description in a form of a map of translations.

parentId.description: Unique identifier of the parent category. No parentId in the body indicates that this is a root category.

localizedSlug.description: Provides localized category name or code without diacritics for the URL.

ecn.description: List of external category numbers (ECNs) unique for every category.

code.description: Unique category identifier, defined by the tenant. Required for category of type `CLASSIFICATION`.

position.description: Category position, set in relation to the categories on the same level (sharing the same parent) in the tree.

published.description: Flag indicating whether the category has been published or not.

ownClassificationMixins.description: List of classification mixins defined by this category.

mixins.description: Custom category attributes that need to be included directly in the mixins object.
A key-value map, where key is a mixin name and value is a link to the mixin schema.

required.description: Indicates whether the mixin is required.

OwnClassificationMixin.description: Classification mixin defined for a given category.
